highlights.title: ​Export to markdown from a page or blog post
highlights.body: Click on the Export to Markdown item in the Actions menu to start the export process.
highlights.explanation: Export to Markdown in the actions menu of a page

highlights.title: Customize your export
highlights.body: Support for including or excluding comments and the ability to include HTML for markup that isn't supported natively by Markdown (such as underlines and superscript/subscript)
highlights.explanation: Export to Markdown modal open displaying a sample export that includes a table and JavaScript code block.

highlights.title: Bulk-export a whole space
highlights.body: Export all pages and blog posts in a space to Markdown in a ZIP file from the Space Settings screen.
highlights.explanation: Confluence Space Settings screen showing the option to export a whole space.

text.moreDetails:
Export to Markdown for Confluence Cloud enables easy exporting of single pages or entire spaces to Markdown, right from within Confluence.

📄 Export a single page to Markdown from the actions menu

📁 Export a whole space to Markdown in a ZIP file from Space Settings

🛠 Ability to customise your export to include or exclude HTML and comments

🔒 No data ever leaves your Confluence instance

🚀 Built with Atlassian's new Forge development platform for maximum speed and security

Please don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or suggestions!

Also check out Export to Markdown for Jira Cloud.

text.moreDetails:
Export to Markdown for Confluence Cloud enables easy exporting of single pages or entire spaces to Markdown, right from within Confluence.

📄 Export a single page to Markdown from the actions menu

📁 Export a whole space to Markdown in a ZIP file from Space Settings

🛠 Ability to customise your export to include or exclude HTML and comments

🔒 No data ever leaves your Confluence instance

🚀 Built with Atlassian's new Forge development platform for maximum speed and security

Please don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or suggestions!

Also check out Export to Markdown for Jira Cloud.
